Germany
Consular help:Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Berlin or bythe Consulate General in Munchen or bythe Consulate General in Stuttgart.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens:
Regular passport YES
Regular biometric passport NO
Service/Official biometric passport NO
Diplomatic biometric passport NO
Citizens of the Federal Republic of Germany are exempted from the visa requirement when entering, exiting or travelling through Bosnia and Herzegovina to 90 days, for a period of six months, starting from the day of entry.
